visual_review.reference: Approved round dad mockup: black square glasses, natural ears, broad coat and arms, short legs; actual native v8/v9 geometry retained.
visual_review.method: Manually inspected all 193 final Web screenshots in 17 contact sheets, plus full-resolution and enlarged hero samples, and sampled the full 122.44-second actual Web motion recording. Compared silhouette and material details with the approved reference and native renders.
coverage: Depth 1 terrain, corners, barriers and transitions in all four biomes
Depth 2 edges, bedrock, gates intact/partial/cleared and transitions
Five Endless layers and permanent walls
All eleven equipment appearances, idle/walk/impact; worn, Crusher and Deepcore in four directions
All five coat palettes; Surface, Hub and Deepheart
Actual gameplay movement and mining damage in four directions for worn, Crusher and Deepcore
findings: Corrected double-textured color modulation; original texture and cloth palette now render once.
Round body, thick sleeves, short legs and textured equipment remain readable at target viewport.
No detached hands, invalid atlas frames, exposed sprite borders or trouser/boot clipping apparent in reviewed gameplay evidence.
Hero remained grounded and visible across reviewed terrain and transitions.
limitations: Chromium WebGL2 SwiftShader evidence is not a physical iPhone performance measurement.
Contact-sheet and sampled video inspection does not imply exhaustive inspection of every runtime frame.
